normative_extracts.quote: The ready promise resolves once all currently loading FontFace objects have finished loading and layout has settled.
Screenshots depend on browser version, OS font rendering, and GPU drivers; generate and verify baselines inside the same Docker image.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Deterministic visual testing eliminates OS text-shaping and timing variance by pinning a Linux software rasterizer, awaiting font readiness, and disabling mid-frame animations.

production_failures.symptom: Every PR fails visual regression in GitHub Actions despite clean local diffs on macOS
production_failures.root_cause: Baselines were generated on macOS CoreText at DPR 2 while CI rendered on Linux FreeType at DPR 1.
production_failures.mitigation: Generate and verify all screenshot baselines inside a pinned Playwright Docker container.

production_failures.symptom: Intermittent 15% pixel diff on hero banner button across identical CI runs
production_failures.root_cause: Screenshot fired before web fonts finished loading, capturing system Arial instead of the custom WOFF2 font.
production_failures.mitigation: Await document.fonts.ready and disable CSS animations before calling toHaveScreenshot().
